answer: Re-attestations are stored in tundra and summit lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the violet graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 8 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 9 dollars and 3 days per identity, which turns a 3396 account sybil into a 3 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
